comment: git-guard incident replays (must deny) and neighbours (must allow). cwd values name the shared checkouts and their lane worktrees; rule is the rule id the deny reason must name.

deny.name: pipe-mask replay, orchestrator transcript T:7544 verbatim
deny.command: cd {home}/app && git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline main..origin/main | head -2; git merge --ff-only d52ab67d 2>&1 | tail -1 && git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -2 && echo "- $(date +%H:%M) batch6-gate GREEN d52ab67d; pushed origin/main (3.0.3)." >> ~/state/queue/ledger.md

deny.name: pipe-mask shape as quoted in the audit 5.1
deny.command: git merge --ff-only d52ab67d 2>&1 | tail -1 && git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -2 && echo done

deny.name: pipe into grep then ;
deny.command: git rebase origin/dev | grep -v hint; git log -1

deny.name: git -C commit piped into sed then ||
deny.command: git -C {home}/app/.claude/worktrees/lane-b commit -qm wip | sed -n 1p || echo failed

deny.name: pipe-mask across a newline
deny.command:
git cherry-pick abc1234 2>&1 | tail -3
git push origin abc1234:refs/heads/lane/x

deny.name: push main by name from a lane worktree
push dev by name in grid
shared-checkout replay: reset --hard in the shared App checkout
cd into the shared Kit checkout, then checkout -- .
review: a quoted "<<EOF" does not hide the next line
review: a commented <<EOF does not hide the next line
review: a heredoc inside "$(...)" is still stripped
deny.command:
git commit -qm "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: it's "quoted" (a)
EOF
)" && git reset --hard a780eb7b

deny.name: restore . in a subdirectory of the shared checkout
checkout <ref> -- path in the shared checkout
stash pop of the shared top entry

allow.name: audit neighbour: pipefail and a SHA refspec
allow.command: set -o pipefail; git merge --ff-only d52ab67d | tail -1 && git push origin d52ab67d:refs/heads/main

allow.name: audit neighbour: read-only git piped into head
set -euo pipefail on its own line
allow.command:
set -euo pipefail
git merge --no-ff lane/x 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo merged

allow.name: pipeline last in the command
pipe characters inside a quoted commit message
allow.command: git commit -qm "fix: a | tail; b && c" && git log -1

allow.name: heredoc commit message with pipes
allow.command:
git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
feat: x | tail && y

body; more
EOF
git log -1 --oneline

allow.name: shared-checkout neighbour: reset --hard in a lane worktree
checkout -- . via -C into a lane worktree
clean -fd in a temporary clone
restore --staged only touches the index
push dev by SHA
push dev and main by full SHA
push a lane branch by name
push main by name outside the three repos
tagged stash push
allow.command: git stash push -u -m lane-404-tag && git stash list --format='%H %gs'

allow.name: stash -m without a subcommand
stash apply by SHA
logged override
allow.command: GIT_GUARD_OK="owner asked to reset main" git reset --hard origin/main

allow.name: git words inside a grep pattern
allow.command: grep -n 'git push origin main' docs/development.md | head -3 && echo ok

allow.name: branch switch in a lane worktree
allow.command: git checkout -B lane/404-agent-hooks integrate/queue-347 && git log -1
